The color of an eggplant is purple.

**Beginning:**
Ben, living on an isolated farm, discovers a unique ability to communicate with the local animals. As he delves deeper into their lives, he learns about their daily struggles and forms strong bonds with them, eventually deciding to become their champion.

**Climax:**
An impending storm threatens to destroy the farm and endanger all the animals. Ben orchestrates a daring and complex plan to protect his new friends, risking his own safety to execute the rescue mission.

**Resolution:**
Ben's plan succeeds, saving the farm and its inhabitants. Through this experience, Ben finds a newfound sense of purpose and solidifies his role as the guardian of the farm's animal community.
